methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing for leading PDF-tool vendors collected on 2026-06-14. Several official pricing pages either timed out (adobe.com/acrobat/pricing), returned 404 (foxit.com, gonitro.com/pricing), failed TLS verification (pdf.foxit.com), or geolocated to EUR rather than USD (ilovepdf.com, sejda.com, pdfexpert.com); for those vendors USD figures were taken from reputable 2026 pricing-comparison pages (Capterra, G2, Xodo, Tekpon, costbench, aiproductivity.ai, toolradar) and each such fallback is stated in that vendor's provenance, with a second independent corroboration URL added wherever possible. monthlyUsd is the recurring monthly cost for the smallest billable unit; where a vendor publishes only an annualized monthly rate the month-to-month rate is noted and annualDiscountPct is set when both figures are published, else null. Per-user/per-seat tiers are billingModel per_seat with the per-user price recorded; fixed single-account tiers are flat; usage-metered or quote-only tiers with no flat rate are custom. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers have monthlyUsd null (never guessed). minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan because they do not apply to PDF software. hipaa/baa are set true/false only where explicitly stated, else null; PDF editors generally do not advertise HIPAA/BAA so most are null.

vendors.name: Adobe Acrobat
vendors.provenance: adobe.com/acrobat/pricing timed out repeatedly via fetch; US list prices reflect Adobe's published 2026 Acrobat plans as compiled by Xodo's 2026 Adobe Acrobat pricing guide and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of Adobe US pricing. Individual/team monthly figures are the annual-billing-billed-monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where published.

plans.name: Acrobat Standard (Individual)
plans.notes: $14.99/month on annual billing ($179.88/year), single user. View, edit, convert, export and e-sign PDFs on desktop and web (Windows/web only for Standard).

plans.name: Acrobat Pro (Individual)
plans.notes: $19.99/month on annual billing ($239.88/year); $29.99/month on month-to-month billing. Single user. Full PDF editing across desktop/web/mobile, advanced e-sign, compare and redact.

plans.name: Acrobat Studio (Individual)
plans.notes: $24.99/month on annual billing ($299.88/year), single user. Acrobat Pro plus AI Assistant and PDF Spaces.

plans.name: Acrobat Standard for teams
plans.notes: $16.99/user/month on annual billing ($203.88/user/year). Adds Admin Console and centralized license management over the individual SKU.

plans.name: Acrobat Pro for teams
plans.notes: $23.99/user/month on annual billing ($287.88/user/year); $35.99/seat/month on monthly billing. Team management plus full Acrobat Pro PDF and e-sign features.

plans.name: Enterprise / Acrobat Sign Solutions
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Volume licensing via Admin Console, SSO, advanced deployment and compliance options.

vendors.name: Smallpdf
vendors.provenance: smallpdf.com/pricing returned truncated/JS-only content via fetch; USD figures taken from Capterra's 2026 Smallpdf pricing page (monthly-billing rates) and corroborated by toolradar.com's 2026 Smallpdf pricing review (which lists the lower annual-billing rates). Both figures noted per plan.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Basic PDF tools with daily file and size limits (around 2 tasks/day, ~5MB files). Single user.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $15/month on monthly billing; ~$9/month when billed annually (toolradar). Single user. Unlimited document processing, all tools, batch processing, strong compression, OCR/scan-to-Word, desktop apps, no ads.

plans.name: Pro for Teams
plans.notes: $12/user/month on monthly billing (2+ users); ~$7/user/month when billed annually (toolradar). Adds team management, priority support, data extraction, volume discounts.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Customizable user roles, centralized billing and priority support for larger organizations.

vendors.name: pdfFiller
vendors.provenance: pdffiller.com/en/pricing.htm returned 404 via fetch; USD figures taken from Capterra's 2026 pdfFiller pricing page (annual-billing per-user rates) and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of pdfFiller pricing that lists matching annual rates and the higher month-to-month rates.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $8/user/month billed annually; $20/month on month-to-month billing. Fill, edit, sign and export PDFs, fillable forms, 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $12/user/month billed annually; $30/month on month-to-month billing. Adds reusable templates, version history, more signature/send features.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $15/user/month billed annually; $40/month on month-to-month billing. Adds advanced signing, document analytics and premium support.

vendors.name: Foxit PDF Editor
vendors.provenance: foxit.com/pdf-editor/pricing.html returned 404 and pdf.foxit.com/pricing failed TLS verification via fetch; USD figures taken from costbench.com's 2026 Foxit PDF Editor pricing breakdown and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of Foxit pricing.

plans.name: PDF Reader
plans.notes: Free. View and print PDFs, annotation tools, form filling, basic digital signatures.

plans.name: PDF Editor
plans.notes: $10.99/license/month month-to-month; $10.83/license/month billed annually ($129.99/year). Create and edit PDFs, convert to Word/Excel/PowerPoint, OCR, 20GB cloud storage, 20 AI credits/month.

plans.name: PDF Editor+
plans.notes: $13.99/license/month month-to-month; $13.33/license/month billed annually ($159.99/year). Adds mobile access (iOS/Android), 150GB storage, 150 eSign envelopes/year, AI redaction.

plans.name: PDF Editor Perpetual
plans.notes: One-time perpetual license (no published self-serve flat monthly price; contact sales/checkout for quote). Desktop only, no recurring fees, no automatic upgrades.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales (10+ users). Admin console, centralized management, usage monitoring, compliance tracking, dedicated account manager.

vendors.name: iLovePDF
vendors.provenance: ilovepdf.com/pricing renders prices in EUR (geolocated), so USD figures were taken from Tekpon's 2026 iLovePDF pricing page and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of iLovePDF USD pricing.

plans.name: Basic (Free)
plans.notes: Single user. Limited document processing and batch sizes, restricted file sizes, web only, no AI credits.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $4/month billed annually ($48/year); $7/month on month-to-month billing. All tools, unlimited tasks, Web/Mobile/Desktop access, 2,000 AI credits, priority support, ad-free.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales (25+ users). All Premium features plus dedicated account manager, custom contracts, SSO, regional processing options.

vendors.name: Nitro PDF
vendors.provenance: gonitro.com/pricing renders the PDF tier prices via JS and returned no figures for the Standard plan via fetch; USD figures taken from aiproductivity.ai's 2026 Nitro PDF Pro pricing page and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of Nitro PDF pricing.

plans.name: Nitro PDF Standard
plans.notes: $15/user/month (annual subscription); some 2026 sources cite ~$17.70/user/month. Create, convert, combine and edit PDFs, annotation, e-signatures, AI productivity tools, admin portal, 24/7 support.

plans.name: Nitro PDF Plus
plans.notes: Quote-only / custom (volume discounts). All Standard features plus enterprise security (SSO, domain control, Azure Information Protection), Nitro Analytics, Smart Redact, dedicated customer success.

plans.name: Nitro PDF Classic (perpetual)
plans.notes: One-time 3-year license, ~$270 per license (not a recurring monthly plan). Windows desktop only; create, edit, convert, combine, split, password-protect PDFs.

vendors.name: Sejda PDF
vendors.provenance: sejda.com/pricing renders prices in EUR (geolocated), so USD figures were taken from Capterra's 2026 Sejda pricing page and corroborated by a 2026 web-search aggregation of Sejda USD pricing.

plans.name: Desktop+Web Free
plans.notes: No signup required. Limited to ~3 tasks/day with page, hourly and file-size limits.

plans.name: Web Week Pass
plans.notes: One-time $5 for 7 days of Sejda Web access (not a recurring monthly subscription, so monthlyUsd is null). No Sejda Desktop access.

plans.name: Web Monthly
plans.notes: $7.50/month, single user. Browser access to all PDF tools, unlimited processing, OCR up to 100 pages, batch processing, 500MB uploads. No Sejda Desktop access.

plans.name: Desktop+Web Annual
plans.notes: $63/year billed annually (~$5.25/month, ~30% cheaper than Web Monthly). Adds a year of Sejda Desktop access alongside Sejda Web.

vendors.name: PDF Expert
vendors.provenance: pdfexpert.com/pricing renders prices in EUR (geolocated), so USD figures were taken from a 2026 web-search aggregation of Readdle PDF Expert USD pricing and corroborated by the US Mac App Store listing. Apple-ecosystem product (Mac/iPad/iPhone).

plans.name: Premium (Yearly)
plans.notes: $79.99/year billed annually (~$6.67/month), single user across Mac/iPad/iPhone. PDF editing, OCR, convert to Word/Excel/PPT, e-signature, AI PDF assistant, translate. 30-day money-back guarantee.

plans.name: Premium (Lifetime)
plans.notes: One-time $199.99 lifetime license (not a recurring monthly plan, so monthlyUsd is null). Same Premium feature set, no subscription.
